findings.summary: Slack identity link Confect impls do not enforce the approved durable binding contract
findings.details: S10-T01 is approved as a real local Slack identity-binding contract: authenticated WorkOS users create short-lived single-use link intents, Slack confirmation consumes the stored pending nonce exactly once, exact teamId + slackUserId is recorded durably, revocation and current role/connection generation are enforced, and declared typed failures are reachable. The task-owned Confect impls instead return deterministic Effect.succeed values, hard-code current user identity, never write/query/patch slackIdentityBindings, accept any consume input, and revoke without loading or authorizing a binding. The pure plan helpers cover part of the desired behavior in unit tests, but the registered typed API that downstream Slack intake will call does not implement the contract.
